run_jsp_datagen: run the jsp data generator to create synthetic job shop scheduling samples as JSON files
run_sample_job: run sample_job to generate a single random job with length and resource size arrays
generate_jsp_dataset: generate a job shop scheduling dataset split into train, validation, and test JSON files
refactor_sample_job: refactor sample_job to support custom resource allocation strategies beyond dominant and other categories
review_main: review main to understand how samples are generated, split into 80/10/10 train/val/test, and saved as JSON
